retrieved_at_source: osm3s.timestamp_osm_base from the Overpass API response

corridor.description: West Lafayette, Indiana -> Indianapolis, Indiana along I-65

nominatim_rate_limit: max 1 request/sec, enforced with a 1.1s sleep between calls
processing_steps: 1. Ran the Overpass query above to fetch I-65 motorway ways in the bbox, then fuel/rest_area/services/truck_stop features within ~1.5km of those ways (62 raw elements returned).
2. Dropped features with no real name or brand tag, and any tagged disused:*/abandoned:*/was:* (50 named candidates remained).
3. Hard-excluded osm-way-229125508 (Lebanon Rest Area - I65 SB) per founder decision: tagged landuse=construction and toilets=no.

4. De-duplicated features representing the same physical business (same name/brand within ~300m), keeping the record with the most complete tag set -- e.g. a fuel node inside a travel-centre way was dropped in favor of the more complete record (42 clusters remained).
5. Selected 18 of the 42 clusters for geographic spread across the full corridor and preference for interchange-area stops (multiple truck-stop/travel-centre chains: Love's x2, Flying J, TA).

6. For each selected stop, used addr:* OSM tags for the address when present; otherwise reverse-geocoded the stop's lat/lon via Nominatim (5 of 18 stops) and recorded address_source accordingly. Nominatim's own place name (e.g. it returned 'Pilot' near the Flying J Travel Center point) was never used -- only its address component fields (house_number, road, city/town/village, state, postcode). Name/brand always comes from the original OSM tags.

7. Mapped categories strictly from OSM tags per the app's existing category vocabulary (Gas, Restroom, Open Now, Well Lit in apps/mobile/data/mock-stops.ts): amenity=fuel -> 'Gas'; toilets=yes -> 'Restroom' (no stop in this dataset carries a toilets tag, so none received 'Restroom'). highway=rest_area/services has no equivalent category in the app vocabulary, so those 4 travel-centre stops were left with an empty categories array rather than inventing a category. opening_hours=24/7 was present on some stops but was not mapped to any category, since no '24-hour' category exists in the app vocabulary.

excluded.name: Lebanon Rest Area - I65 SB
excluded.reason: Founder-directed exclusion; also tagged landuse=construction and toilets=no in OSM
